comparison.objective: Route and clip a cable while preserving an existing retention point; candidate depins one terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-cable routing and clip seating versus localized tab release with a blade and coupled tool-wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Cable follows the post gap and remains seated in both clips, hands clear; candidate requires one terminal extracted without collateral release or damage. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve wire handling, but the tested abilities—routing/retention versus connector depinning—are meaningfully different.
